title: Find Similar Pitcher Seasons — similar_pitchers
text: Finds pitcher seasons similar user-supplied statistical profile. Comparisons restricted pitcher seasons matching selected starter reliever classifications. Starter reliever classifications manually imputed based innings pitched, ratio starts relief outings, numerical gap starts games pitched, subject matter knowledge.

title: Find Similar Pitcher Seasons — similar_pitchers
code: similar_pitchers(   lob_pct,   gb_pct,   hr_fb,   k_pct,   bb_pct,   barrel_pct,   hardhit_pct,   is_starter,   is_reliever,   n = 5,   data = Pitching )

title: Find Similar Pitcher Seasons — similar_pitchers
text: lob_pct Left--Base Percentage. gb_pct Ground Ball Percentage. hr_fb Home Run per Fly Ball Percentage. k_pct Strikeout Percentage. bb_pct Walk Percentage. barrel_pct Barrel Percentage. hardhit_pct Hard-Hit Percentage. is_starter Starter Indicator: either 0 1. is_reliever Reliever Indicator: either 0 1. n Number similar player-seasons return. Default 5. data Pitching data frame. Default Pitching.

title: Find Similar Pitcher Seasons — similar_pitchers
text: data frame containing similar pitcher seasons.

title: Find Similar Pitcher Seasons — similar_pitchers
code: ## Traditional Starter Example starter_results <- similar_pitchers(   lob_pct = 81,   gb_pct = 43,   hr_fb = 9,   k_pct = 30,   bb_pct = 6,   barrel_pct = 7,   hardhit_pct = 38,   is_starter = 1,   is_reliever = 0,   n = 10 )  ## Traditional Reliever Example reliever_results <- similar_pitchers(   lob_pct = 77,   gb_pct = 52,   hr_fb = 13,   k_pct = 38,   bb_pct = 9,   barrel_pct = 6,   hardhit_pct = 42,   is_starter = 0,   is_reliever = 1,   n = 10 )  ## Swingman Example swingman_results <- similar_pitchers(   lob_pct = 72,   gb_pct = 35,   hr_fb = 7,   k_pct = 20,   bb_pct = 3,   barrel_pct = 5,   hardhit_pct = 30,   is_starter = 1,   is_reliever = 1,   n = 10 )
